description:
Get life expectancy at birth.
- National, by race and sex, 1900–2018 (the default). Races: 'All Races', 'Black', 'White'.
- By state and sex, 2018–2021: give `state` (a state, or 'all' for every state ranked).
For more recent mortality trends, use cdc_mortality_rates.

state.description: State name, two-letter code or FIPS code, or 'all', for state-level data (2018–2021)

name: cdc_life_expectancy
